shellCommands.command: git status --short && find pages -type f 2>/dev/null | sort && cat package.json
for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/* styles/* next.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo ==== $f; cat "$f"; done
rm -r pages && rm components/AppProvider.js && npx next typegen && npx tsc --noEmit

set -e
for route in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/9999 /not-a-route /api/posts /api/posts/7; do printf '%s ' "$route"; curl -s -o /tmp/fx-route-response -w '%{http_code}\n' "http://localhost:3100$route"; head -c 120 /tmp/fx-route-response; echo; done
for spec in 'POST /api/posts {"title":"Test","content":"Hello"}' 'POST /api/posts {}' 'PUT /api/posts/7 {"title":"Updated"}' 'DELETE /api/posts/7 {}'; do set -- $spec; printf '%s %s ' "$1" "$2"; curl -s -X "$1" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$3" -o /tmp/fx-route-response -w '%{http_code}\n' "http://localhost:3100$2"; cat /tmp/fx-route-response; echo; done
printf 'unsupported: '; curl -s -X PATCH -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3100/api/posts
curl -s http://localhost:3100/blog/9999 | head -c 1200; echo; git status --short; git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css; test ! -d pages && echo 'pages removed'
npm run build && npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --check && git status --short
git diff --check && git status --short && cat next-env.d.ts && test ! -d pages && echo 'pages removed'
